answer.says: The canopy is a sensible concession to the climate. I shall take the water; the body must be maintained if the spirit is to continue its work.
answer.thought: The guard’s practicality is refreshing; he sees the immediate need without the metaphysical weight of a fast. I am indeed hollow, and the cafeteria is the closest approximation to a table here. I will accept the water and seek sustenance, for I cannot review my notes on the ethics of the state while my own constitution crumbles from lack of fuel.

errors: nothing is sold at the IIC
warnings: walks to where he already is; treated as stay
